qualifier: tryptophan-kynurenine de novo route and nicotinate
name: Tryptophan-kynurenine catabolism and nicotinate NAD+ metabolism
rationale: All members concern NAD+ synthesis, salvage or breakdown via tryptophan-kynurenine-quinolinate or nicotinate; the tryptophan/kynurenine arm is what the NAD/CoA and polyamine confusables lack.

qualifier: transcriptional chaperone induction by ATF6, XBP1, ATF4, CREB3
name: ER unfolded protein response transcriptional chaperone induction
rationale: Members are the ER UPR arms activating chaperone and stress genes and their control of ER stress and beta-cell apoptosis; confusables instead carry stress translational control, mitochondrial UPR or negative UPR regulators.

name: Incretin, glucagon and nutrient GPCR control of hormone secretion
rationale: Members are GPCR signaling by GLP-1/GIP, glucagon, free fatty acid, hydroxycarboxylic acid, somatostatin and acetylcholine regulating insulin or GH secretion; confusables lack the incretin synthesis and glucagon-family receptor members.

core: Congenital disorders of glycosylation type I
qualifier: dolichol, mannose donor and flippase defects (not ALG transferases)
name: CDG type I from dolichol, mannose donor and flippase defects
rationale: All are CDG caused by defects in dolichol synthesis/activation (SRD5A3, DOLK), mannose donor supply/use (PMM2, MPDU1) or LLO flipping (RFT1), unlike confusables of ALG glycosyltransferase or DPM/MPI defects.

name: Osteoclast bone resorption and bone mineralization regulation
rationale: Members regulate osteoclast differentiation, fusion and resorption plus bone mineralization; confusables instead carry osteoblast regulation or IGF responses.

name: Golgi ribbon assembly and disassembly
rationale: All members concern Golgi stack/ribbon structure and its disassembly, whereas confusables are Golgi vesicle trafficking and COPI transport.

name: Sema3A repulsion and collateral axon sprouting control
rationale: Members are Sema3A-plexin/CRMP repulsion and regulation of collateral sprouting and nerve branching; confusables lack Sema3A signaling or carry netrin/ephrin guidance and injury regeneration.

core: Class I cytokine receptor JAK-STAT signaling
qualifier: GH, prolactin, leptin and gp130 cytokines
name: GH, prolactin, leptin and gp130 cytokine JAK-STAT signaling
rationale: Members are JAK-STAT signaling by GH, prolactin, leptin, thrombopoietin and IL-6-family cytokines and their control of body growth; confusables carry GH secretion, thyroid hormone or erythropoietin signaling.

core: Pyruvate dehydrogenase conversion of pyruvate to acetyl-CoA
name: Pyruvate dehydrogenase conversion of pyruvate to acetyl-CoA
rationale: All members concern PDH-catalysed pyruvate decarboxylation to acetyl-CoA and its regulation, distinct from the OGDH/BCKDH and TCA/malate-shuttle confusables.

qualifier: commissural midline and retinal ganglion cell axons
name: SLIT-ROBO axon guidance at midline and optic nerve
rationale: Members are SLIT-ROBO signaling to Rho GTPases and its control of commissural and retinal axon pathfinding; confusables carry netrin, ephrin and L1 guidance instead.

name: Complement C3 and C5 cleavage and opsonization
rationale: Members concern C3/C5 activation, opsonization and the GZMK complement route, whereas confusables cover classical/alternative initiation and complement regulation.

qualifier: small-RNA silencing and RNA-binding protein decay
name: miRNA silencing and RNA-binding protein control of mRNA decay
rationale: Members are miRNA/siRNA biogenesis and silencing, ARE-binding protein stabilization/decay, deadenylation and translational control of specific mRNAs; confusables carry 3'-end processing, nuclear decay, splicing or maternal mRNA clearance.

qualifier: GABA reuptake and synaptic vesicle loading
name: GABA reuptake and synaptic vesicle neurotransmitter loading
rationale: Members are SLC uptake of GABA/taurine and vesicular loading and acidification; confusables carry glutamate handling or monoamine metabolism.

qualifier: serotonin and histamine synthesis, uptake and receptors
name: Serotonin, histamine, muscarinic receptor signaling and serotonin turnover
rationale: Members are serotonin, histamine and muscarinic receptor signaling plus serotonin/histamine synthesis, uptake and secretion; confusables share the receptor signaling but lack the amine turnover members.

name: Glutamate, glutamine, proline and aspartate nitrogen metabolism
rationale: Members are glutamate/glutamine/proline/aspartate metabolism linked through 2-oxoglutarate and transamination to glycine/glyoxylate; confusables carry glycine conjugation, alanine/gluconeogenesis or urea cycle.

name: Regulation of fibrotic matrix deposition and connective tissue repair
rationale: Members regulate ECM assembly, collagen, myofibroblast and fibroblast fate and connective tissue replacement in wound healing; confusables carry fibroblast migration, miRNA or TGF-beta/SMAD signaling.

name: Neural progenitor proliferation and midbrain dopaminergic neuron differentiation
rationale: Members regulate neuroblast/progenitor proliferation and neuronal specification in midbrain, forebrain and related tissues; confusables carry cortical migration or sympathoadrenal development.

qualifier: sialic acid, GDP-mannose and lysosomal oligosaccharide breakdown
name: Sialic acid, GDP-mannose and lysosomal oligosaccharide sugar metabolism
rationale: Members concern sialic acid synthesis/catabolism, mannose and GDP-mannose synthesis and lysosomal glycoside catabolism; confusables carry UDP-GlcNAc, nucleotide-sugar transport, GPI or dolichol synthesis.

name: Embryonic craniofacial and limb morphogenesis
rationale: All members are embryonic head, face and limb morphogenesis; confusables carry somitogenesis, ear or pharyngeal gland and palate development.

name: Telomere replication with D-loop and t-circle control
rationale: Members concern telomere semi-conservative replication and resolution of telomeric D-loops/t-circles, unlike confusables on capping, C-strand synthesis or DNA topology.

core: Small GTPase control of membrane traffic
name: Rab and ARF GTPase regulation of secretory and recycling traffic
rationale: Members are Rab/ARF signaling with constitutive secretion, Golgi membrane targeting, endocytosis and receptor recycling; confusables lack the Rab GAP/ARF members or carry Golgi structure and endosome-Golgi routes.

name: Folate one-carbon and methionine-SAM cycle metabolism
rationale: Members are folate/THF interconversion and transport plus methionine and SAM metabolism and remethylation defects; confusables lack folate members or the methionine-cycle defects.

qualifier: AP-1/FOSL targets downstream of growth signals
name: AP-1 immediate-early transcriptional response to growth signals
rationale: Members are AP-1/FOS and NR4A immediate-early programs induced by KRAS, TNF and growth factors with fibroblast proliferation; confusables carry mRNA decay, stress kinases or MAPK feedback.

name: Heme biosynthesis and iron-sulfur cluster assembly
rationale: Members are heme/protoporphyrin synthesis and regulation plus cytosolic Fe-S assembly and mitochondrial ABC export; confusables lack heme synthesis, covering Fe-S only, iron transport or erythrocyte gas exchange.

core: Unfolded protein and integrated stress responses
qualifier: ER and mitochondrial, via eIF2 kinases
name: ER and mitochondrial unfolded protein and integrated stress responses
rationale: Members are ER UPR arms, eIF2 kinase (GCN2, HRI, PERK) translational control and mitochondrial UPR; confusables carry chaperone folding, FOXO signaling, ER targeting or heat shock.
